content.value_statement: Spreadsheet analysis can become slow when workbooks contain many sheets or messy tables. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical pandas workflows for cleaning, summarizing, charting, and exporting Excel data.
actual_capabilities: Guides pandas workflows to read single sheets and all sheets from Excel workbooks.
Shows grouping, filtering, sorting, and calculated metric examples for tabular data.
Explains how to create pivot tables and save them as Excel reports.
Demonstrates chart generation from spreadsheet data with matplotlib.
Shows cleaning steps for duplicates, missing values, whitespace, dates, and numbers.
Covers formatted Excel exports with column sizing, fills, fonts, and workbook saves.
limitations: Requires Python packages such as pandas, openpyxl, xlrd, xlsxwriter, or matplotlib.
Examples assume local files are available and readable by the agent environment.
Does not inspect encrypted workbooks, repair corrupt files, or execute Excel macros.
Does not replace accounting review, compliance validation, or manual data quality checks.

use_cases.title: Summarize Sales Workbooks
use_cases.description: Create regional totals, product summaries, and profit margin calculations from Excel sales data.

use_cases.title: Clean Exported Operations Data
use_cases.description: Remove duplicate rows, normalize dates and numbers, and prepare messy spreadsheet exports for reporting.

use_cases.title: Build Formatted Report Files
use_cases.description: Generate Excel outputs with pivot tables, charts, adjusted columns, and highlighted values.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel analysis skill to inspect sales.xlsx. List the sheet names, preview each sheet, and summarize the available columns.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Spreadsheet Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel analysis skill to clean messy_data.xlsx. Remove duplicates, handle missing values, trim text fields, and convert dates and amounts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pivot Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel analysis skill to create a pivot table from sales_data.xlsx. Summarize sales by region and product, then save a report file.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Full Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel analysis skill to merge quarterly workbooks, calculate profit margin, create charts, format the output, and explain each step.

output_examples.input: A sales workbook with region, product, revenue, cost, and date columns.
output_examples.output: The result is a regional sales summary, a profit margin column, and a ranked list of top products.

output_examples.input: A messy customer export with duplicate rows, blank values, and inconsistent date formats.
output_examples.output: The result is a cleaned workbook with duplicate rows removed, missing values handled, and date fields normalized.

output_examples.input: Quarterly Excel files that need one management report.
output_examples.output: The result is a merged report workbook with pivot summaries, charts, adjusted column widths, and highlighted results.

best_practices: Keep a backup copy of the original workbook before cleaning or overwriting data.
Specify sheet names, important columns, and expected output files in the prompt.
Review generated calculations and charts before using reports for business decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to analyze protected or confidential workbooks without proper authorization.
Do not overwrite the only copy of a source workbook during cleanup.
Do not treat generated summaries as a substitute for domain or finance review.

faq.question: What file types does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Excel workbooks, especially .xlsx files, and tabular spreadsheet data handled through Python libraries.

faq.question: Can it create charts from workbook data?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for bar charts and pie charts using matplotlib.

faq.question: Can it process multiple sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to inspect all sheets in a workbook and process each sheet by name.

faq.question: Does it support pivot tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It demonstrates pandas pivot tables and saving pivot output to an Excel report.

faq.question: Does it run Excel macros?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides Python data analysis guidance and does not include macro execution.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
